verdict.rationale: Devin exposes an API for creating sessions programmatically (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9) which could technically be called from a CI/CD pipeline, but there is no documented CI/CD integration, webhook trigger on build/test failure, or example of automatically fixing broken builds. Community evidence also raises doubts about reliability (13.8% issue resolution rate) that would undercut confidence in an unattended CI/CD fix workflow.
